data.name: NEON DRIFT ULTRA
data.detailed_description:
NEON DRIFT ULTRA — Acid Webpunk Racing

Immerse yourself in a hyper‑stylized cyberpunk trip where the asphalt glows, the music pulsates, and every turn is a chance to drift right into the neon abyss.

NEON DRIFT ULTRA is an adrenaline racing arcade game in which the soul of the classic Soviet car industry meets the dazzling aesthetics of webpunk. A juicy 3D image, deep pumping in the garage and a built—in track editor - and all this in a glamorously buggy VHS environment.

WHAT'S INSIDE?

🔥 18 unique trails + endless customizations

Loop through tracks that defy reality, from the simple NEON OVAL to the mind-blowing FINAL VOID. Each track has elevation changes, turns, and hidden secrets. And if you don't have enough ready—made stuff, launch the built-in editor and build your own highways. Save, share, and compete on custom tracks.

A garage full of VAZ legends

  • Take a ride on the iconic Lada, each model is waiting for its own tuning:

  • VAZ‑2106 "Tuning" — classic sedan

  • VAZ‑2101 "Kopeyka" — legend of roads

  • VAZ‑2107 "Seven" — square headlights, square character

  • VAZ‑2109 "Chisel" — angular hatchback

  • Lada Priora — modern style

  • Lada Vesta — the sharp edges of the new century

Customize everything:

  • Coloring — eight neon colors to choose from

  • Decals — stripes, flames, neon lighting

  • Body kits — spoilers, arch extensions, door sills and more

  • Performance — upgrades to speed, acceleration, handling, grip, and nitro

Deep but accessible arcade physics

Drift is not just for beauty, it is the basis of style. Press the SPACE bar to put the car into a turn, accumulating the sliding angle and exiting the curve faster than your rivals. Tap SHIFT and the nitro acceleration will pull you forward, leaving a trail of neon particles behind. Cars cling to the asphalt, slide and collide with pleasant weight, and smart AI makes every race intense to the last meter.

Sintwave‑soundtrack, born in neon

The music changes with the race: relaxing synth pads on the menu are replaced by energetic arpeggios and powerful drums on the track. The roar of the engine, the screech of tires, the crunch of collisions — all this creates the perfect sound background for high-speed races.

VHS / glitch visual

The world is drowned in neon fog, glowing curbs and pulsating rays of light. Turn on the post‑processing and get authentic VHS stripes, color fringing and light noise. The aesthetics of the 80s home video, turned out to the fullest.

The progression you want to race for

Earn money on your wins and spend it in the garage: unlock new cars, buy upgrades, change the exterior. Set lap records to put your name on the leaderboard. Finish first and open the next track. A total of 18 built-in tracks, divided by difficulty, are waiting for their conqueror.

Evil rivals

You are not alone on the asphalt. SEREGA, DIMON, KOLYAN and other cyber‑punks are against you. Everyone has their own driving style and level of aggression. They struggle for the trajectory, make mistakes, and don't let you relax until the finish line.

Route editor — become an architect

If you get inspired, switch to a 2D editor and draw your perfect route. Place the dots, change the height, adjust the width, the number of circles and the difficulty. And then immediately go for a test drive. All custom tracks are saved and available at any time.

GET READY TO DRIFT

NEON DRIFT ULTRA is not just a racing game. This is a neon trip in the parallel 90s, where Lada cars rule the streets and the horizon is made of light. If you just want to drive or break records, the asphalt is waiting.

Turn on the backlight and catch the perfect circle!
